name: Funes's Hoard
purpose: Gives the assistant a read-only, privacy-filtered memory of what the user was doing on this computer: app, window, files, commits, over time. Also federates the other local Hoard apps (screen, clipboard, audio) into one merged, citable timeline.
notes: Local episodic memory: foreground app/window, idle/away, files opened and commits made, with privacy rules applied before storage. Read-only for the assistant except pausing recording, and a pause from the assistant never shortens one you set. Federates: when the sibling apps Argus's Hoard (screen), Echo's Hoard (clipboard) and Scribe's Hoard (audio) are running on this machine, the recall/recall_search tools merge their local history with Funes's own into one time-sorted, citable timeline (docs/RECALL.md); a source that is not running is reported as unavailable, never fatal. Funes never reads those apps' data directly -- only their own read-only agent APIs, over loopback.
